import html from typing import List # Example template; replace with the actual one from your project. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

Posted by: {user_name}

{post_content}
{post_tags}
""" def build_post_html( user_name: str, post_heading: str, post_content: str, post_tags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Build a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- user_name : str Author's name. post_heading : str Title of the post. post_content : str Main body of the post. post_tags : list[str] List of tags to display. Returns ------- str A safe HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user-supplied strings to prevent XSS and malformed HTML. safe_user_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) safe_post_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_post_content = html.escape(post_content, quote=False) # Build the tags section: each tag wrapped in a . safe_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ] tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) # Insert the sanitized values into the template. html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( user_name=safe_user_name, post_heading=safe_post_heading, post_content=safe_post_content, post_tags=tags_html ) return html_output.strip()
